title: Senior Manager, Special Events
description:
Senior Manager, Special Events


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


Reporting to the Head of Special Events, the Senior Special Events Manager will serve as a senior leader within the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027 organization. This role is a pivotal member of the Local Organizing Structure, working in close collaboration with the FIFA Zurich Project Team, internal functional areas, Host Cities, Commercial Affiliates, Government Authorities, and other key stakeholders to deliver exceptional, world-class event experiences that elevate the tournament's global impact.

Role Purpose: The Senior Special Events Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, creative development, operational execution, and overall management of all official FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027 special events. The role ensures seamless, high-quality delivery aligned with FIFA's brand standards, commercial objectives, and global audience expectations.

Impact & Scope: The Senior Special Events Manager will play a critical role in shaping some of the most visible and globally broadcast moments of the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027. From milestone launches to the Final Draw, this position directly contributes to the tournament's international perception, commercial success, and legacy in Brazil.

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong strategic vision, exceptional organizational and leadership skills, creative excellence, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, fast-paced, and multicultural environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Strategic Event Planning & Delivery

Lead the end-to-end planning and execution of major tournament-related events, including but not limited to:

  • Oficial Dinner
  • Final Draw
  • Brand Launch
  • Mascot Launch
  • Team Workshop
  • Volunteers Kick-Off Event
  • Guest activities, when required
  • Coordination of Legends Matches
  • Participation in pre-match ceremonies
  • Additional milestone and stakeholder events throughout the tournament lifecycle

  • Develop comprehensive event strategies, timelines, and delivery frameworks to ensure consistent quality, innovation, and alignment with FIFA's global positioning.

  • Creative Direction & Experience Design

  • Drive the creative vision and thematic development of each event in alignment with FIFA brand guidelines.

  • Oversee event concepts, production design, show flow, staging, entertainment, and guest experience.
    Ensure all events reflect the prestige, inclusivity, and global significance of the FIFA Women's World Cup.

  • Operational & Logistical Oversight

  • Manage all operational aspects including venue selection, supplier procurement, production management, accreditation, guest services, protocol, and security coordination.

  • Ensure integrated planning across broadcast, marketing, communications, hospitality, and competition functions.

  • Implement detailed contingency and risk management plans to guarantee flawless delivery.

  • Budget & Financial Management

  • Develop, monitor, and control event budgets across multiple initiatives.

  • Optimize resource allocation while maintaining premium standards.

  • Manage vendor contracts and ensure cost efficiency, compliance, and financial transparency.

  • Stakeholder & Partner Coordination

  • Serve as the primary liaison for internal departments, Host Cities, commercial partners, sponsors, government authorities, and international delegations related to special events.

  • Coordinate with the FIFA Zurich Project Team to ensure alignment with global event standards and reporting structures.

  • Manage protocol requirements and high-profile guest engagement including FIFA leadership, participating member associations, VIPs, and media.

  • Team Leadership & Management

  • Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary project team across different FIFA Functional Areas, fostering collaboration, accountability, and high performance.

  • Oversee external agencies and production partners, ensuring clear deliverables and performance standards.
    Build a positive team culture aligned with FIFA values.

YOUR PROFILE


Education

  • A Master's degree (MBA) in Event Management, Sports Management, Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
  • Additional executive education in large-scale event production, leadership, or project management is advantageous.

Experience

  • Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in large-scale international event management, preferably within global sporting events, major entertainment productions, or multinational organizations.
  • Proven experience leading high-profile, broadcast-level events such as draws, ceremonies, gala dinners, launches, or government-level functions.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multi-million-dollar budgets and complex procurement processes.
  • Strong background in stakeholder management involving senior executives, sponsors, government authorities, and international delegations.
  • Experience working in matrix organizations and collaborating with global headquarters or international governing bodies is highly desirable.
  • Previous experience within FIFA tournaments or comparable mega-events (e.g., Olympic Games, continental championships, global expos) is a strong advantage.

Skills & Competencies

Strategic & Operational Excellence

  • Strong ability to translate strategic objectives into comprehensive event delivery plans.
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple large-scale initiatives simultaneously.
  • Advanced knowledge of event production, show calling, staging, audiovisual integration, and broadcast requirements.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Proven leadership capability with experience managing multidisciplinary teams and external agencies.
  • Ability to inspire, mentor, and drive high performance in fast-paced environments.
  • Strong decision-making skills under pressure.

Financial & Commercial Acumen

  • Solid budget planning, financial oversight, and cost-control expertise.
  • Understanding of sponsorship integration and brand alignment within event environments.

Communication & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to manage high-level protocol and VIP relations with professionalism and discretion.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in Portuguese and/or Spanish is highly desirable.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and solutions-driven.
  • Resilient and adaptable in dynamic, multicultural environments.
  • Creative mindset with strong attention to brand experience and innovation.
  • High integrity and alignment with FIFA's values of inclusion, teamwork, and excellence.

Requiriments

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

Fixed Term - Full Time

Brazil

title: analista de suporte
description:
A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos , de 04/03/1966, de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.
A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.
A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.
Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.
Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Instalar e manter os sistemas informatizados, identificar e resolver problemas, realizar modificações nas instruções de operação em vigor e adaptar, a fim de prover suporte técnico na sua área de responsabilidade.
Prestar atendimento de suporte aos usuários internos e externos, a fim de soluciona-los;
Realizar atendimento de chamados através de telefone, sistema de chamados ou e-mail, garantindo o registro de todas as ocorrências;
Acompanhar o suporte prestado por empresas terceirizadas e implantações de novas Unidades;
Realizar controle para distribuição e compra de periféricos, tais como: mouse, teclado, estabilizador, etc.;
Realizar cotação para contratação de serviços relacionados à Tecnologia da Informação;
Elaborar especificações técnicas para a compra de itens relacionados à Tecnologia da Informação;
Acompanhar disponibilidade de serviços de telefonia, CFTV e ponto eletrônico, bem como acionar os prestadores de serviço sobre a manutenção dos mesmos;
Administrar e realizar o controle de usuários do Active Directory;
Instalar e solucionar problemas de impressoras em rede, garantindo o bom funcionamento;
Detectar defeitos e auxiliar na correção de instalação de softwares, garantindo o bom funcionamento dos aplicativos;
Prestar assistência no suporte aos usuários nos aspectos de hardware e software, envolvendo a montagem de computadores, reparos e configurações, a fim de evitar que ocorram problemas;
Efetuar instalação de Sistema Operacional (Windows), instalação de impressoras em rede e realizar instalação e configuração de softwares (Pacote Microsoft Office, navegadores, sistemas ERP), a fim de facilitar o processo de trabalho dos usuários;
Instalar, treinar e dar suporte a aplicativos desenvolvidos pela empresa e/ou aplicativos de terceiros;
Configurar computadores em rede e realizar a manutenção da estrutura física de computadores, garantindo os acessos aos recursos de rede;
Apoiar profissionais da equipe de TI nas atividades relacionadas à Tecnologia da Informação, garantindo o bom andamento dos trabalhos;
Organizar e receber os equipamentos no estoque de TI testando e selecionando peças para utilização no parque de equipamentos de TI, garantindo que os mesmos atendam os requisitos técnicos;
Instalar e configurar Antivírus e Anti-Spyware, a fim de prevenir e remover vírus, trojans e spywares, etc;
Administrar servidores de impressão, antivírus e serviços de e-mail corporativo, a fim de garantir o bom funcionamento dos serviços;
Efetuar instalação, substituição de hardware, instalação de drivers, corrigir problemas de conflito de hardware e realizar manutenção preventiva em servidores, garantindo o bom funcionamento;
Compartilhar recursos de rede em servidores, tais como: pastas, impressoras, computadores, etc, garantindo o acesso e segurança das informações;
Configurar internet através de conexão direta via rede ou através de discador, personalização do Internet Explorer, identificação de problemas de navegação;
Configurar e-mail através de gerenciador de e-mail Outlook, utilizando servidores POP, SMTP e IMAP, a fim de facilitar a comunicação entre os funcionários da empresa;
Instalar e Monitorar o funcionamento de Servidores Windows ou Linux, a fim de manter o bom funcionamento e desempenho dos sistemas;
Filtrar e direcionar chamados de suporte técnico;
Efetuar abertura de chamado e acompanhar manutenção nos links de internet das operadoras responsáveis;
Executar rotinas de backup de dados dos usuários;
Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM;
Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais LGPD;
Realizar as atividades das áreas/setores, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.

Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de contribuir diretamente para um futuro mais saudável e sustentável, trabalhando em um ambiente onde propósito e impacto caminham juntos.
 

Essa posição ficará baseada no Rio de Janeiro/RJ.

Suas Responsabilidades

Esse cargo dá a VOCÊ  a oportunidade de liderar atividades chaves para progredir na SUA carreira, algumas delas são:

  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico de tecnologia, traduzindo necessidades de negócios em soluções escaláveis e inovadoras em dados, analytics e IA.

  • Construir e manter relacionamentos sólidos com stakeholders internos e externos, garantindo alinhamento estratégico.

  • Definir requisitos de dados e analytics que gerem valor mensurável ao negócio.

  • Garantir alinhamento das soluções com arquitetura corporativa, segurança e governança.

  • Integrar múltiplas fontes e plataformas de dados, com foco na qualidade e consistência.

  • Evoluir o ecossistema de dados e analytics, habilitando casos de uso avançados de IA e promovendo a sustentabilidade das soluções.

Por que VOCÊ?

Suas qualificações:

Estamos à procura de pessoas/profissionais com essas características para alcançar nossos objetivos:

  • Graduação em Tecnologia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

  • Experiência prévia em empresas farmacêuticas em posições gerenciais, como Tech Business Partner ou Data/Insights Manager.

  • Conhecimento sólido em Data & Analytics, arquitetura de tecnologia e processos de integração de dados.

  • Experiência comprovada na gestão de equipes técnicas de engenharia de dados.

JavaScript (ES6), Bootstrap em contexto de templates Django;
Integração com serviços externos (REST/SOAP ou WSDL; consumo resiliente);
Inglês técnico para leitura (documentação, libs, Issues).
Conhecimento prático de testes (pytest ou unittest; mocks; fixtures; cobertura);
Segurança básica web: CSRF, XSS, controle de acesso, saneamento de dados.
ESCOLARIDADE
Graduação: Administração, Engenharia, Contabilidade, Direito, Economia, Análise de Tecnologia da Informação, Administrador de Tecnologia da Informação ou outras áreas correlatas.

Experiência com sistemas de planejamento, logística ou operação offshore;
Modelo C4 / documentação arquitetural viva;
Otimização de consultas complexas;
Uso de linters (pylint), formadores (black/ruff/isort) e tipagem gradual (mypy);
Observabilidade (CloudWatch);
Conhecimento em otimização de geração de grandes arquivos em streaming (Excel).
ATRIBUIÇÕES
Evoluir e manter uma solução, garantindo qualidade, performance, segurança e escalabilidade, operando tanto no backend (Django + DRF + PostgreSQL) quanto no frontend (templates Django, JavaScript) e nas integrações (SAP, S3);

Desenvolver e manter recursos de escalonamento, carteiras e histórico de planejamento;
Criar e otimizar consultas e modelos no PostgreSQL (índices, transações, migrações consistentes);
Trabalhe com WebSockets (Django Channels) para atualizações em tempo real;
Implementar e manter exportações Excel (openpyxl) com regras de negócio complexas;
Integrar e monitorar rotinas de sincronização com sistemas externos (ex.: SAP);
Armazenamento manipulável de arquivos em AWS S3 (boto3).
Garantir integridade e segurança do sistema de permissões e perfis;
Contribuir com testes automatizados (pytest / unittest Django) e manter a cobertura mínima acordada;
Revisar PRs, propor melhorias arquiteturais e seguir padrões internos (lint, estrutura de apps, internacionalização);
Diagnosticar e otimizar gargalos de performance (DB, IO, memória, consultas N+1, websockets);
Evoluir gradualmente o frontend (melhor UX, modularização JS, possível modernização futura);
Apoiar pipeline CI/CD, conteinerização (Docker / docker-compose) e execução local consistente;
Documentar: endpoints, fluxos críticos, decisões técnicas e diagramas (C4 / README's técnicos);
Zelar por observabilidade (logs estruturados, considerações e tratativas de questões).

title: Analista de Controles internos
description:
Sua missão como Analista de Controles internos será;

  • Mapear, documentar e redesenhar processos das áreas Contábil, Financeira, Fiscal, Custos e Controles Internos, garantindo aderência às políticas e padrões corporativos.
  • Modelar fluxos de processos utilizando BPMN 2.0 e ferramentas de modelagem (Bizagi, Visio, ARIS ou similares).
  • Desenvolver e manter dashboards e relatórios em Power BI para acompanhamento de KPIs estratégicos e operacionais das áreas da Controladoria, incluindo: ciclo de fechamento contábil,aging de contas a pagar e receber, reconciliações e fluxo de caixa; desempenho orçamentário e análise de variações; custos operacionais e margens por centro de custo; cumprimento de obrigações fiscais e prazos de fechamento; acompanhamento de planos de ação e efetividade de controles.
  • Realizar análises de dados operacionais e financeiros, identificando oportunidades de otimização de recursos, aumento de eficiência e reduçPOr isão de riscos.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de melhoria contínua, aplicando metodologias Lean, Kaizen, PDCA e análise de valor agregado.
  • Atuar na automação de processos Contábil, Financeira, Fiscal, Custos e Controles Internos em parceria com áreas de TI e transformação digital.
  • Elaborar e revisar procedimentos, políticas e instruções de trabalho (POPs) das áreas da Controladoria.
  • Apoiar a integração entre Controles Internos e Processos, garantindo conformidade com padrões de auditoria e governança.

title: Mid-Level Software Engineer
description:
Company Overview


At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We're a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that's critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview


The Cloud Platform Services organization is the engine behind our global safety and security ecosystem. We don't just build software; we build the bridges that connect critical information to the heroes who need it most. Our mission is to help public safety professionals and enterprises find the "needle in the haystack" by leveraging cutting-edge AI, video, audio, and advanced search analytics. By transforming massive oceans of data into clear, actionable intelligence, we empower people to be their best in the moments that matter.

Job Description


As a Software Engineer on our Data Platform Search team, you will play a pivotal role in Solving for Safer by increasing the discoverability of life-saving data. You won't just write code; you will design and implement the search architecture that helps a dispatcher or first responder locate critical information in seconds.

Your day-to-day will involve taking ownership of significant features, from initial technical design to final deployment within a Kubernetes environment. You will act as a human-centered innovator—partnering with teams to nail down requirements, conducting rigorous code reviews, and ensuring our systems remain secure and resilient. Whether you are optimizing a microservice or mentoring a junior team member, your work directly contributes to a world where clarity is power and context is key.

Basic Requirements


Location:

This is a remote position located in Brazil. You'll be working with a team with core hours of 9:00 - 15:00 MST/MDT. Occasional meetings can be scheduled for as early as 8:00 MST/MDT and as late as 17:30 MST/MDT.

## Basic Requirements:

  • 4+ years of professional experience in object-oriented programming (C#/.NET or Java)
  • Advanced English Proficiency
  • Proven experience developing REST-based and Messaging-based APIs within cloud-based microservice architectures (e.g., Kubernetes)
  • Deep practical knowledge of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and modern DevOps practices including CI/CD and automation
  • Solid understanding of secure coding principles and common vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top 10)
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field

## Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Haves):

  • Experience building or maintaining search systems using Elasticsearch or equivalent technologies
  • Proficiency in CI/CD tools like Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
  • Knowledge of data streaming and event ingestion services such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or EventHub
  • Familiarity with C4 Architecture diagrams and Domain-Driven Development (DDD)
  • Experience with Docker, NodeJS, and TypeScript

Diferencial possuir conhecimento em práticas de segurança aplicadas a ambientes virtualizados, incluindo hardening de hypervisors e gestão de acesso;

title: Urbanist
description:
This job is with United Nations, an inclusive employer and a member of myGwork – the largest global platform for the LGBTQ+ business community. Please do not contact the recruiter directly.
Result of ServiceThe Urbanist reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.
Work LocationHome based
Expected durationEleven (11) months
Duties and ResponsibilitiesBackground The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, local authorities, and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda, with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. Through a partnership with the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) and the Municipality of Belo Horizonte, UN-Habitat is working as Implementing Agency to implement the project named "Urban Qualification in a Key Neighborhood of Belo Horizonte." UN-Habitat will focus on the outcome "Improved Belo Horizonte Municipal infrastructure and tools to develop effective options for social housing and urban planning in Izidora," which aims to enable Izidora´s population to have safe and sustainable access to community infrastructure and affordable housing. The region of Izidora corresponds to an area of about 9.5 km², in the northern vector of the city, next to the southern border of the city of Santa Luzia. This area is in the largest green area of the city, counting around 280 water sources and 64 creeks, including part of the watershed Belo Horizonte's main water source. Part of Izidora has been squatted and is divided into four urban informal settlements - Esperança, Vitória, Helena Greco and Rosa Leão – totalizing approximately 1.5 km² and hosting about 4,200 precarious homes (which could be up to 7,000 families, given that there are no precise numbers since 2010), with families in situations of extreme poverty and without any available public infrastructure and relative services, as many Brazilian cities. During the Habitat III Conference in 2016, Izidora was highlighted as one of the most serious urban land conflicts in Latin America. Therefore, the new efforts of the municipality are a recognition of the issues, as well as the urgency of acting. The interest of the Municipal Administration is to implement works and actions so that Izidora becomes a model under the principles of sustainability and resilience. This is a chance to promote an innovative experience in using the precepts of the New Urban Agenda (NUA) and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) at local level to reverse a situation of socioeconomic and territorial vulnerability. To properly implement this project, an Urbanist is required to ensure the good execution of the work programme. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Urbanist reports to the Head of Brazil Office who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Urbanist will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities:
Review of the program, layout, 3D modeling, façade elements, and preliminary architectural and urbanistic design.
Analyze and review basic architectural projects, regarding aspects of dimensioning, urbanism, thermal comfort, ventilation, acoustics, energy efficiency, specifications of materials.
Prepare reports and technical analysis on basic architectural and urbanistic projects.
Analyze, review, and propose changes to the technical drawings to ensure quality standards.
Apply advanced analysis techniques to propose solutions to problems related to architecture and compatibility of projects.
Provide technical guidance to designers, planners, engineers, and architects.
Collaborate with other team members to prepare the necessary technical documents corresponding to the project.
Participate in meetings with other members of the technical team.
Perform any other technical support tasks to support the project team as required. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Urbanist shall evaluate projects for two (2) occupations of Izidora Neighborhood, which are divided into three (3) areas, and assist the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1: Macroplan Description: A consortium will design projects, and the Urbanist will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 35 days after signing the contract. Product 2: Preliminary Urban Design – Area 1 Description: A consortium will design projects, and the Urbanist will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 70 days after signing the contract. Product 3: Basic Urban Planning Project – Area 1 Description: A consortium will design projects, and the Urbanist will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 105 days after signing the contract. Product 4: Preliminary Urban Design – Area 3 Description: A consortium will design projects, and the Urbanist will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 140 days after signing the contract. Product 5: Basic Urban Project – Area 3 Description: A consortium will design projects, and the Urbanist will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 175 days after signing the contract. Product 6: Landscaping Project – Area 1 and 3 Description: A consortium will design projects, and the Urbanist will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 200 days after signing the contract. Product 7: Use, Operation, and Maintenance Manual. Description: Technical analysis report regarding use, operation, and maintenance manuals. Expected delivery date: 235 days after signing the contract. Product 8: Projects compatibility – Area 1 and 2 Description: A consortium will design compatibility studies, and the Urbanist will verify the deliveries. The analysis includes three project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 270 days after signing the contract. Product 9: Projects compatibility – Area 3 Description: A consortium will design compatibility studies, and the Urbanist will verify the deliveries. The analysis includes three project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 330 days after signing the contract.
Qualifications/special skillsEducation Required:
Postgraduate degree (Lato Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Architecture and Urbanism, or related fields, or additional four (4) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement.
Bachelor's degree (Lato Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Architecture and Urbanism. Work experience:
A minimum of six (6) years of progressively responsible experience in basic urbanistic or social housing projects in Brazil is required.
Experience in the context of urbanization of informal settlements is desirable.
Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
Good computer skills in Windows, such as Microsoft Office, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and Web search engines are required.
Experience and skills in using CAD are desirable. Competencies
Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation. approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision. Proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively. Listen to others, interpret messages correctly, and respond appropriately. Show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed. solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management, and consensus facilitation skills. ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity. sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability. willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
The person will propose formats and procedures that allow for the efficient implementation of the activities related to project development.
The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.
Languages
English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required.
Working knowledge of English or Spanish is desirable.

Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. Result of ServiceThe Flora Specialist reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.
Work LocationHome based
Expected durationEleven (11) months
Duties and ResponsibilitiesBackground The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, local authorities, and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda, with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. Through a partnership with the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) and the Municipality of Belo Horizonte, UN-Habitat is working as Implementing Agency to implement the project named "Urban Qualification in a Key Neighborhood of Belo Horizonte." UN-Habitat will focus on the outcome "Improved Belo Horizonte Municipal infrastructure and tools to develop effective options for social housing and urban planning in Izidora," which aims to enable Izidora´s population to have safe and sustainable access to community infrastructure and affordable housing. The region of Izidora corresponds to an area of about 9.5 km², in the northern vector of the city, next to the southern border of the city of Santa Luzia. This area is in the largest green area of the city, counting around 280 water sources and 64 creeks, including part of the watershed Belo Horizonte's main water source. Part of Izidora has been squatted and is divided into four urban informal settlements - Esperança, Vitória, Helena Greco and Rosa Leão – totalizing approximately 1.5 km² and hosting about 4,200 precarious homes (which could be up to 7,000 families, given that there are no precise numbers since 2010), with families in situations of extreme poverty and without any available public infrastructure and relative services, as many Brazilian cities. During the Habitat III Conference in 2016, Izidora was highlighted as one of the most serious urban land conflicts in Latin America. Therefore, the new efforts of the municipality are a recognition of the issues, as well as the urgency of acting. The interest of the Municipal Administration is to implement works and actions so that Izidora becomes a model under the principles of sustainability and resilience. This is a chance to promote an innovative experience in using the precepts of the New Urban Agenda (NUA) and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) at local level to reverse a situation of socioeconomic and territorial vulnerability. To properly implement this project, a Flora Specialist is required to ensure the good execution of the work programme. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Flora Specialist reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Flora Specialist will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Analyze, review and, when necessary, propose adjustments in tree inventories, restoration of degraded areas plans, environmental degradation analysis and characterization, nature-based solutions, vegetal sowing, and landscaping projects. b) Prepare reports and technical opinions about flora specifications on Izidora neighborhood's urbanization projects. c) Analyze, review, and propose changes to the technical drawings of graphic projects to ensure quality standards. d) Provide technical guidance to designers, planners, and engineers. e) Collaborate with other team members to prepare the necessary technical documents corresponding to the project. f) Participate in meetings with other members of the technical team. g) Perform any other technical support tasks to support the project team as required. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Flora Specialist shall evaluate projects for two (2) occupations of Izidora Neighborhood, which are divided into three (3) areas, and assist the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1: Flora analysis for vegetal sowing project- Area 1 Description: A consortium will design the vegetal sowing project, and the Flora Specialist will analyze the delivery. The analysis covers three (3) project reviews and technical reports, until the inventory final approval. Expected delivery date: 35 days after signing the contract. Product 2: Flora analysis for vegetal sowing project- – Area 2 Description: A consortium will design the vegetal sowing project, and the Flora Specialist will analyze the delivery. The analysis covers three (3) project reviews and technical reports, until the inventory final approval. Expected delivery date: 70 days after signing the contract. Product 3: Flora analysis for vegetal sowing project- – Area 3 Description: A consortium will design the vegetal sowing project, and the Flora Specialist will analyze the delivery. The analysis covers three (3) project reviews and technical reports, until the inventory final approval. Expected delivery date: 105 days after signing the contract. Product 4: Flora analysis for landscaping – Area 1 Description: A consortium will design the landscaping project, and the Flora Specialist will analyze the delivery. The analysis covers three (3) project reviews and technical reports, until the inventory final approval. Expected delivery date: 140 days after signing the contract. Product 5: Flora analysis for landscaping – Area 3 Description: A consortium will design the landscaping project, and the Flora Specialist will analyze the delivery. The analysis covers three (3) project reviews and technical reports, until the inventory final approval. Expected delivery date: 175 days after signing the contract. Product 6: Flora analysis for degraded area recovery plan Description: A consortium will design the plan, and the Flora Specialist will analyze the delivery. The analysis covers three (3) plan reviews and technical reports, until the inventory final approval. Expected delivery date: 210 days after signing the contract. Product 7: Flora analysis for environmental assessment Description: A consortium will design environmental assessment, and the Flora Specialist will analyze the delivery. The analysis covers three (3) assessment reviews and technical reports, until the inventory final approval. Expected delivery date: 245 days after signing the contract. Product 8: Tree Inventory – Area 1 Description: A consortium will design the inventory, and the Flora Specialist will analyze the delivery. The analysis covers three (3) assessment reviews and technical reports, until the inventory final approval. Expected delivery date: 280 days after signing the contract. Product 9: Tree Inventory – Area 3 Description: A consortium will design environmental assessment, and the Flora Specialist will analyze the delivery. The analysis covers three (3) assessment reviews and technical reports, until the inventory final approval. Expected delivery date: 330 days after signing the contract.

Show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed. solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management, and consensus facilitation skills. ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity. sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability. willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
The person will propose formats and procedures that allow for the efficient implementation of the activities related to project development.
The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.

The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.
Languages
English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required.
Working knowledge of English or Spanish is desirable.

description:

Assistente de Controle de Qualidade - Área Têxtil

As responsabilidades do cargo são:

  • Atuar com controle de qualidade em escritório de importação de tecidos;
  • Cortar e organizar amostras, preencher e organizar fichas de amostras;
  • Organizar arquivos em geral de amostras e arquivo morto periodicamente;
  • Prestar atendimento às solicitações para desenvolvimento de produto, analises de controle de qualidade e à ocorrências de reclamações de clientes, entre outras atividades da área de qualidade;
  • Eventualmente analisar visualmente ou na utilização de instrumentos de medição as especificações técnicas dos produtos, preencher planilhas e fichas de análises;
  • Registrar dados em Excel;
  • Envio de informações via e-mail;
  • Separar e enviar amostras de produtos para laboratórios especializados, onde serão realizados os testes e ensaios específicos;
  • Documentar de maneira precisa os resultados das análises e inspeções realizadas por meio de relatórios, fichas e planilhas de análises;
  • Participar de investigações para determinar as causas das não conformidades e sugerir soluções;
  • Comunicar os resultados e fornecer feedback aos departamentos envolvidos no processo de produção e desenvolvimento;
  • Manter a organização de arquivos em geral de documentos e amostras, incluindo o arquivo morto
  • Prestar atendimento às ocorrências de reclamação de cliente;
  • Ter comprometimento com a qualidade do trabalho e resultados;
  • Analisar amostras de produtos para identificar possíveis desvios de qualidade, analisar visualmente ou na utilização de instrumentos de medição observando as especificações técnicas e cores padrão dos produtos.

description:

Role Purpose
The Enterprise Architect role is responsible for designing and managing the overall architecture of an organization's IT systems and infrastructure. This role involves aligning IT strategy with business goals, creating architectural frameworks, and ensuring that technology solutions are scalable, secure, and efficient. The Enterprise Architect collaborates with various internal and external stakeholders to identify technology needs and guide the implementation of IT initiatives.

Key Responsibilities
As the Enterprise Architect, your key responsibilities are as follows:

  • Establish EA governance, EA frameworks, EA methodology and create EA artifacts, EA standards and best practices.
  • Design and promote architectural standards, guidelines, and best practices across the organization.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to identify business requirements and translate them into architectural solutions.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to inform architectural decisions and recommendation
  • Facilitate architecture review boards and governance processes to ensure compliance with architectural standards.
  • Provide guidance and support to project teams in implementing architectural solutions.
  • Instruct, manage, and mentor development teams
  • Communicate enterprise architecture with other department managers within the organization, outsourcing providers and report on continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Oversee Change Control board, participate in Project Review Board to ensure adherence to architectural standards.

People Responsibilities (Total Team/DRs)
No

Key metrics
EA KPIs such as strategic alignment, business process optimization, innovation enablement, efficiency, architecture compliance and risk management

Key internal relationships
CIO, Deputy CIO, Functional leads, Operations leads, GDPR team, Legal, Finance, Global Security, IT Security, Technology Services, System/Application Owners, Program/Opportunity leads.

Key external relationships
IT vendors in various markets, external consulting experts, EA colleagues at non-profit institutions with similar IT landscape, large global software providers, etc.

The ideal candidate
Essential

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or a related field
  • Master's degree in IT management, business management, or enterprise architecture
  • Certifications such TOGAF, CISSP (for cybersecurity focus), and cloud-specific certifications from providers like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud are beneficial
  • 10 years of relevant experience in Enterprise Architecture, with a background in software engineering, network security, cloud computing, systems analysis, data management or other related fields.
  • Strong understanding of business needs, technology trends, and architectural frameworks.
  • Experience creating and maintaining comprehensive Enterprise Architecture frameworks.
  • Experience with architecture modelling tools CAD, BIM, and 3D modelling software.
  • Strong understanding of IT enterprise systems and platforms (Salesforce, NetSuite, Workday) and architectures
  • Deep knowledge of various technologies, including cloud computing, data management, networking, and security.
  • Ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to analyse complex business problems and develop innovative solutions.
  • Ability to lead and mentor development teams and influence stakeholders.
  • Experience with architectural frameworks and methodologies TOGAF or Zachman, and agile methodologies.
  • Experience with cloud computing, network security, data management, and application integration.
  • High level understanding and interest of geo-political implications of Open Society's work.
  • Travel is required. Travel frequency depends on the role requirements.

Languages

  • An excellent knowledge of English

What We Offer

  • Exceptional opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact; from a generous annual professional development allowance for every employee to onsite training and learning conversations with visiting experts.

  • Excellent benefits and perks to promote well-being and a healthy work-life balance, including:

  • Generous time off and flexible work arrangements.

  • Employer-paid health insurance and dental plans for individuals and families (no employee contribution required).
  • Exceptional retirement savings plan (non-contributory for employees) and life insurance.

  • Progressive paid parental leave, reproductive and family planning support, and much more.

  • A commitment to nurturing a diverse and inclusive workplace, so you can bring your whole self to work and make a positive impact.

Open Society Foundations aim to establish vibrant and inclusive democracies where governments are accountable to their citizens. Our operating model organizes grantmaking around specific, time-limited projects, developed alongside support for established partners, enabling us to respond swiftly to emerging needs. We are committed to promoting human dignity, equality, and rights; reimagining democratic ideals and practice; and advancing equity in governance systems.

Guided by our founder's values and the belief in the art of the possible, we engage directly with global entities, individuals, and policymakers through grants, advocacy, impact investing, and strategic human rights litigation to drive positive change. At the heart of our mission is a deep commitment to rights, equity, and justice, inspiring every action we take.

title: Mecanico de Refrigeração
description:
O Mecânico de Refrigeração é responsável pela instalação, manutenção e reparo de sistemas de refrigeração e climatização, como ar-condicionado, câmaras frigoríficas, freezers e outros equipamentos similares. Este profissional assegura o funcionamento eficiente e seguro dos sistemas de refrigeração, realizando diagnósticos, trocas de componentes e ajustes técnicos necessários para manter os ambientes adequadamente refrigerados. Principais Responsabilidades:Realizar a instalação de sistemas de refrigeração e ar-condicionado em ambientes comerciais, industriais e residenciais, seguindo as normas técnicas e de segurança. Executar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em equipamentos de refrigeração, identificando problemas, realizando ajustes, substituição de peças e limpeza de componentes para garantir o desempenho ideal. Inspecionar sistemas de refrigeração para detectar falhas, vazamentos de gás, problemas elétricos e mecânicos, utilizando ferramentas específicas para diagnósticos precisos. Realizar reparos em compressores, condensadores, evaporadores, válvulas de expansão e demais componentes dos sistemas de refrigeração, garantindo a restauração completa do equipamento. Realizar a carga e recarga de gás refrigerante nos sistemas, conforme as especificações técnicas e normas ambientais. Testar e ajustar os equipamentos após a instalação ou reparo, verificando a temperatura, pressão, fluxo de ar e outros parâmetros para assegurar o funcionamento correto. title: Analista de Dados Pleno
description:
Você quer fazer parte de uma empresa de tecnologia que está há mais de 20 anos no mercado, que não apenas é parceira premier do Google Cloud, mas também já foi 5 vezes premiada como Partner of the year? Uma empresa que além de ser fera naquilo que faz, também valoriza e leva a sério o compromisso com cada IPNETER, possuindo há 6 anos consecutivos o selo Great Place To Work. Pois é, essa empresa existe. Essa empresa é a IPNET Além disso, somos comprometidos com a inclusão, abraçando cada forma única de ser humano, independente de etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, habilidades físicas ou mentais. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas. Aqui, não apenas reconhecemos, mas também celebramos as diferentes identidades, experiências e talentos de cada pessoa que faz parte do nosso time. E, estamos com uma vaga aberta para Analista de Dados Pleno , que irá atuar dentro do Growth Time , no segmento de Experiência do Cliente , sendo responsável por:Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados com base em uma arquitetura robusta, aplicando boas práticas de engenharia e processamento de dados. Manipular, extrair e analisar grandes volumes de dados utilizando SQL com domínio técnico. Desenvolver dashboards e análises operacionais de forma autônoma, apoiando a tomada de decisão. Atuar em todas as etapas do ciclo de dados:ingerir, transformar, modelar e analisar informações. Criar e manter camadas de dados otimizadas para visualizações e relatórios. Automatizar fluxos de dados priorizando eficiência, escalabilidade e facilidade de manutenção. Trabalhar com estruturas particionadas no BigQuery, otimizando performance em ambientes analíticos. Definir, acompanhar e validar métricas operacionais em parceria com os times de negócio. Entendemos que para atender as demandas da vaga, é necessário que o candidato possua:Graduação completa em Engenharia de Dados, Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados e afins. Conhecimento em SQL avançado, com experiência em ambientes de cloud data warehouse, especialmente BigQuery. Experiência em modelagem de dados voltada para BI e uso analítico. Vivência com pipelines de dados, incluindo processos de ingestão, transformação e preparação para visualização. Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados, como Looker Studio, Power BI ou similares (preferencialmente Looker). Familiaridade com processos de ETL/ELT, utilizando scripts em Python, dbt ou ferramentas equivalentes. Conhecimento em orquestração de dados com Cloud Composer (Airflow). Na IPNET by Vivo, acreditamos no trabalho híbrido como forma de fortalecer nossa cultura e acelerar nosso engajamento, respeitando, ao mesmo tempo, a flexibilidade. Por essa razão, nossa proposta consiste em trabalhar 2X na semana home-office e 3X presencialmente no escritório. Atualmente, contamos com dois escritórios no Brasil:um no Rio de Janeiro (Zona Portuária/Santo Cristo) e outro em São Paulo (Cidade Monções/Sede Eco Berrini). Reconhecemos a importância dos benefícios, e por isso, nosso pacote contempla:Auxílio Refeição/Alimentação Auxílio Transporte Plano de Saúde Plano Odontológico Auxílio Home-Office Wellhub Seguro de Vida Auxílio Creche/Babá Happy Day no mês do seu aniversário Parcerias com instituições educacionais, tanto de idiomas quanto acadêmicas Se você se identificou com os requisitos descritos acima, não pense 2 vezes. Ciclos de decisão mais criteriosos
Comunicação baseada em informação e confiança
Restrições éticas e regulatórias
Necessidade de atendimento consultivo e qualificação rigorosa

NOSSO POSICIONAMENTO

Capacidade de conduzir conversas consultivas, sem pressão excessiva ou promessas vazias.
Organização extrema para gerir pipeline, tarefas e CRM.

Perfil orientado a resultado, com responsabilidade e compromisso com processo.
Inteligência emocional e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.

Salário fixo compatível com o mercado + comissões agressivas, diretamente atreladas às metas e à qualidade das oportunidades geradas.
Modelo de remuneração meritocrático, onde performance consistente é reconhecida e recompensada.
Treinamento e capacitação contínua em vendas consultivas, comunicação estratégica, CRM e fundamentos de marketing digital e tráfego pago.
Possibilidade real de crescimento dentro da área comercial, com plano de evolução baseado em desempenho e maturidade profissional.

title: Security Specialist
description:
Who Are We?
Decentralized Masters is at the forefront of DeFi education globally. In just two years, we have grown from a pioneering pair of co-founders to over 130 dedicated professionals. Today, we are recognized as one of the fastest-growing enterprises in the sector, with industry insiders predicting our evolution into a unicorn company by 2030. Operating on a bootstrapped model, we are on track to achieve an impressive $50 million in revenue this year alone.
Our Impact
While our growth has been remarkable, we take even greater pride in the success of our clients. To date, we have empowered over 4000 investors to break into the DeFi world. At Decentralized Masters, we don't just offer education; we cultivate a powerhouse of knowledge combined with an engaging community, innovative technology, and a team of leading DeFi and blockchain experts. Our commitment is to deliver unparalleled resources designed for long-term success in the world of DeFi and Web3, ensuring our members not only safeguard but also enhance their financial future.
Our Vision
Our goal is to create the largest and most influential DeFi ecosystem the world has ever seen, starting with becoming the gold standard in DeFi education. This vision is ambitious, transformative, and poised to change the landscape of digital finance.
Are You Ready?
This is more than just a job; it's an opportunity to shape the future of Web3 technology and education. Are you ready to be part of our vision to redefine what's possible in DeFi and beyond? Apply below, and let's explore this journey together.
Check us out here:
What will you be doing?
We are seeking a Security Specialist to develop, maintain, and continuously improve the security infrastructure across Decentralized Masters and our new SaaS venture. This role focuses on operational security, data protection, risk prevention, and proactive threat mitigation.
You'll work cross-functionally with engineering, data protection, compliance, operations, and product teams to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of our systems, data, and customer assets.
This is a hands-on role, ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment.
Key Responsibilities
Operational & Technical Security
Monitor, analyze, and respond to security events across systems, cloud environments, applications, and internal tools
Implement and manage SIEM, IDS/IPS, endpoint protection, vulnerability scanners, and logging infrastructure
Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and coordinate remediation with engineering teams
Oversee secure configuration baselines for infrastructure, servers, cloud accounts, and internal systems
Implement and enforce Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies, tools, and controls to prevent unauthorized data transfers, including hands-on work with data classification and monitoring systems
Perform detailed data flow mapping to understand how customer data moves across internal systems, SaaS apps, APIs, and third-party integrations
Cloud Security
Secure cloud environments (AWS preferred) including data at rest and in transit using encryption and cloud-native security tools
Manage cloud access policies, network segmentation, secrets management, and continuous monitoring
Risk Management & Compliance
Support compliance frameworks including GDPR, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and crypto-specific security standards as required
Develop and maintain internal security policies, procedures, and security controls
Partner with the Data Protection & Information Security Officer to ensure alignment across security, privacy, and data governance
Access & Identity Management
Serve as the Access & Control Monitoring expert, managing IAM, RBAC policies, least-privilege access, MFA, and anomaly detection systems
Perform regular access reviews, privilege audits, and segregation-of-duty checks
Maintain strong audit logging practices and monitoring of access behavior
Security Awareness & Culture
Deliver training, simulations, and internal education to strengthen internal security awareness
Lead phishing simulation programs and social engineering prevention initiatives
Incident Response
Lead the incident response process: detection, escalation, containment, investigation, and post-incident review
Maintain and improve the incident response playbook; run annual and quarterly tabletop exercises
Secure Development & SaaS Security (Bonus)
Collaborate with engineering teams to embed secure-by-design practices into our SaaS products
Conduct application security reviews, threat modeling, and code analysis (bonus)
Contribute to architecture decisions for new features and infrastructure
Requirements
What You Will Bring
Must-Have
3+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information security, or security operations
Hands-on experience with Data Loss Prevention (DLP) tools and data classification frameworks
Strong data flow mapping expertise with the ability to trace data across systems, integrations, and APIs
Solid understanding of cloud security concepts, encryption, and cloud-native security tools (AWS preferred)
Expertise in IAM and Access Control Monitoring, including least-privilege models, RBAC, MFA, and anomaly detection
Familiarity with audit logging, SIEM tools, vulnerability management, and endpoint security
Experience with incident response processes and playbooks
Strong understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, threat actors, and common attack vectors
Working knowledge of compliance standards such as GDPR, SOC 2, and data protection regulations
Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical teams
Nice-to-Have
Experience working in fintech, blockchain, or DeFi environments
Familiarity with cryptographic concepts, wallets, smart contracts, or key-management practices
Certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GSEC, GCIH, OSCP, CCSP, or similar
Experience automating security workflows using scripting languages
Exposure to ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II audits, or similar security frameworks
Benefits
What We Offer
Competitive salary package
Flexible 40-hour workweek
Unlimited PTO and flexible work schedules
Team off-sites and events
Fully remote work setup — join our global team from anywhere
Are You Ready?
This is more than a job; it's an opportunity to shape the future of Web3 education and finance. If you're a visionary leader ready to drive our mission and help us achieve unicorn status, we want to hear from you.
Apply now to join us in redefining what's possible in DeFi and beyond.

Buscamos um(a) Tech Lead que colabore ativamente nas decisões que envolvem a construção de um produto do zero, capaz de fundar a engenharia do produto, definir padrões e construir uma base sólida, pragmática e escalável.

R$12K | PJ Modelo hibrido na Barra da Tijuca - RJ

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar a concepção técnica do produto do zero
  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de software (backend, frontend, infraestrutura e segurança)
  • Tomar decisões técnicas considerando risco, custo e impacto no negócio
  • Prover contexto técnico para que Produto possa melhor definir as prioridades
  • Garantir qualidade, observabilidade, logs e auditabilidade desde o início
  • Definir padrões de código, versionamento, CI/CD e documentação mínima
  • Contratar e liderar time técnico
  • Atuar hands-on no desenvolvimento e infraestrutura (não é cargo só de gestão)

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Tech Lead ou Senior Engineer
  • Forte domínio de microsserviços e modelagem de dados
  • Experiência com sistemas transacionais e fluxos de estado (ex: ordens de pagamentos, aprovações entre setores, pedidos, workflows)
  • Capacidade comprovada de traduzir decisões técnicas em impacto de negócio
  • Comunicação clara com times não técnicos
  • Experiência em ambientes de alta responsabilidade operacional
  • Atuar no modelo hibrido na Barra da Tijuca - RJ

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Já ter participado da construção de produto do zero ou liderado grandes refatorações
  • Experiência/histórico de empreendedorismo
  • Experiência prévia em healthtech, fintech ou produtos regulados
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de pagamento e conciliação
  • Vivência em startups early-stage

Stack esperada (não engessada)

  • Backend:
  • Banco de dados: PostgreSQL
  • Frontend: React (web) e/ou React Native
  • Infra: AWS
  • CI/CD, filas e observabilidade básica

A stack final será definida em conjunto — esperamos argumentação técnica, não fidelidade a ferramentas. O que NÃO buscamos

  • Perfil focado apenas em código, sem visão de produto/negócio
  • Overengineering em MVP
  • Pessoas que evitam assumir decisões críticas
  • Tech Leads que não colocam a mão no código
  • Promessas de "escala infinita" antes do produto validar

O que oferecemos

  • Papel estratégico, com alto grau de autonomia
  • Influência direta nas decisões de produto e negócio
  • Ambiente sem microgestão
  • Possibilidade real de crescimento para Head of Engineering
  • Modelo de contratação PJ - Híbrio na Barra da Tijuca
  • Remuneração: R$12k PJ

Este não é um cargo para "liderar time grande".

É um papel para construir a fundação técnica de um produto crítico, com impacto direto em milhares de profissionais de saúde.

Se você gosta de responsabilidade real, decisões difíceis e produtos que não podem falhar — queremos conversar.

Você será responsável pela supervisão, desenvolvimento e performance da nossa equipe executiva comercial.   • Negociação Comercial: Realizar negociações com clientes, buscando oportunidades de incremento de vendas, ações promocionais e fortalecimento do relacionamento comercial.
  • Análise e Reporting: Monitorar resultados, analisar indicadores e reportar o desempenho à gestão, propondo melhorias e ações corretivas sempre que necessário.
  • Interface Estratégica: Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas internas (Marketing, Catálogo, Tecnologia, SAC e Financeiro), garantindo alinhamento estratégico e execução eficiente.
  • Gestão de Gente: Conduzir processos de recrutamento, seleção, admissão e integração de novos colaboradores da equipe, garantindo a manutenção do engajamento e do clima organizacional.

  • Mobilidade: Disponibilidade para visitas frequentes aos clientes e viagens esporádicas.

Suas Competências e Habilidades (Qualificações Necessárias)

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Marketing, Administração ou áreas correlatas
  • Experiência comprovada em CRM, Loyalty ou Customer Experience.
  • Inglês avançado (espanhol é um diferencial).

O que você vai encontrar:

title: International Business Developer Offshore
description:
Lead Success. Drive the Future of Customer Solutions.
We are looking for a customer-focused Business Developer, based in Rio de Janeiro, to develop their career in a rewarding, high-performing, and international team.

What You'll do
The purpose of the role is to develop global accounts and be accountable for specification and sales development. The role involves examining economic and market trends and conditions that affect the company and develop strategies to take full advantage of any changing circumstances. The job holder needs to develop senior relationship contacts within the customer's organization to drive the execution of the account's strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Communication skills to create trust through active listening, influencing without authority, negotiation skills.
  • Long-term strategic thinking to explain and transmit the targets & strategy to customers, peers and management.
  • Plan a week, a month, a year in accordance with the strategy.
  • Able to influence internal and external stakeholders around the strategy while understanding external stakeholders' pain points and trends to adjust it if need be.
  • Self-driven and working autonomously create their own planning and tasks to reach the targets.
  • Product and application knowledge to be able to address the 80/20 of customer questions in confidence and without requiring the support of back-office functions.
  • Identify, understand and deliver high level system selling value proposition; sell a solution and a product.
  • Senior relationship management skills to be capable and confident while speaking to senior and C-level customers.
  • Project management capabilities to manage complexity of system selling across multiple geographies, functions and customers.
  • Networking (internal and external) and understanding internal processes and tools.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree is required. Master's degree is a plus.
  • English language (spoken, written, read) at an advance level is required.
  • Knowledge in technical and project commercial experience with focus on solutions and engineering specifications for the offshore market
  • Capable of directly influencing customer´s technical specifications and standards
  • Strong presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills required
  • Competency in the use of
  • Understanding of how to get things done in a matrix organization; demonstrated ability to work with all departments (logistics, credit, marketing, technical services, and customer service)

What's In It for You
We really value our people, and we've worked hard to develop a reward package that reflects this. Some of our benefits include:

  • Annual Bonus according to results
  • Private Health Insurance
  • Company Car
  • Paid leave to work on charitable projects
  • Hybrid scheme of work with 50% of flexibility
  • Employee resource groups focused diversity and sustainability topics
  • Among others

Why Hilti
Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we're driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you'll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you'll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.

Commitment to Inclusion
At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

Legal Notice
When applying to a position at Hilti, you can expect a people-centric recruitment process where every application is reviewed by a human (automated notifications are triggered by our recruiting team). Personalized feedback isn't provided for applications that don't reach hiring manager interview stage, the overall process—including evaluations and interviews—typically takes 3 to 6 weeks, with most applicants hearing back within 2 to 3 weeks. For tips and more information, you're encouraged to explore Hilti's career FAQ section.

title: Auxiliar de Serviços Gerais
description:
Você conhece o Club Med?

Temos quase 70 resorts, abertos no verão e no inverno, em 26 países. Oferecemos férias de alto padrão nas montanhas e à beira-mar. Nossos clientes buscam felicidade e liberdade.

Por que você está lendo este anúncio? Porque você quer fazer parte daquele algo a mais que nos diferencia. Você tem as habilidades humanas e profissionais que procuramos.

Oferecemos a você a oportunidade de crescer e se desenvolver rapidamente, juntando-se às nossas equipes brilhantes. Você poderá viajar pelo mundo.

Seu ambiente de trabalho

Evolua em um ambiente de trabalho onde conforto rima com desempenho: estamos comprometidos em equipar nossos funcionários com equipamentos profissionais de qualidade, oferecendo maior autonomia e facilidade de uso. Nosso espírito pioneiro nos incentiva a adotar inovações que aprimoram o conforto de trabalho de nossas equipes e permitem que elas se concentrem no essencial: o relacionamento com o cliente. Cada um de nossos resorts abriga uma dúzia de nacionalidades diferentes, não apenas entre nossos clientes, mas também entre nossos funcionários, o que nos dá a oportunidade de crescer por meio do contato com diversas culturas O compromisso diário do Club Med com o planeta se reflete nos diversos compromissos assumidos pelos nossos departamentos de Acomodação e Recepção, que esperamos estender à maioria dos nossos Resorts, como a redução do uso de plástico, a introdução de garrafas de vidro ou garrafas térmicas de alumínio, etc.

Você é

  • Discreto e organizado: você faz com que nossos clientes se sintam em casa.
  • Atencioso, você oferece um serviço personalizado e uma experiência única a cada cliente.
  • Meticuloso, seu senso de serviço é impecável e você tem um olhar atento aos detalhes.

Você Irá

  • Utilizar equipamentos profissionais de alta qualidade e inovações para garantir conforto no trabalho e maior autonomia.
  • Manter e limpar as áreas comuns (internas e externas) do resort (600 a 1500 hóspedes).
  • Preparar e verificar o conteúdo do carrinho de limpeza (materiais e produtos de limpeza) e o abastecimento de produtos utilizados nas instalações sanitárias. - Limpar e desinfetar as instalações sanitárias nas áreas comuns, lavar pisos, carpetes, móveis, janelas, separar e esvaziar lixeiras, etc.
  • Identificar e comunicar ao departamento de manutenção quaisquer avarias ou danos em móveis e equipamentos.
  • Verificar se o trabalho está sendo realizado de acordo com os elevados padrões de qualidade do Club Med.
  • Garantir a qualidade dos serviços, o cumprimento das normas de saúde e segurança do Club Med (sinalização de áreas escorregadias) e a conservação das instalações.

Todas as nossas vagas são acessíveis a pessoas com deficiência.

A Globo é feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro.

As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data-driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar de forma transversal com as diversas áreas da empresa, garantindo consistência estratégica e execução coordenada.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação Superior Completa;

  • Habilidade para desenvolver materiais executivos e narrativas estratégicas de alto nível;

  • Excel e PowerPoint avançados.

Conhecimentos que te destacam:

  • Pensamento estratégico e visão de longo prazo;
  • Curiosidade e capacidade de antecipar tendências;
  • Colaboração e habilidade de trabalhar em times multidisciplinares;
